name: adr183-continuation-native-5
result: First end-to-end phase 1 in product code: the continuation published the worker2 artifact; the actual installer-provider-apply created the two exact ACL policies and auth roles plus the inspection policy and wrote the inbox; the continuation consumed it, opened the provider inspection and filled the original empty audit Secret. It then stopped at worker/roles (unavailable). Run 6 splits that step and adds a denied class.
